user_prompt: The graph of the function g passes through the point (1,2). The slope of the tangent to the graph at any point (x, y) is given by g'(x) = 6x − 12. What is g(x)? Show all your work.

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer:
Integrate the derivative:
\[
g'(x)=6x-12 \quad\Rightarrow\quad g(x)=3x^2-12x+C.
\]
Since the graph passes through \((1,2)\), we have \(g(1)=2\):
\[
3-12+C=2 \quad\Rightarrow\quad C=11.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\boxed{g(x)=3x^2-12x+11}.
\]
